name: Random Video
author: Alan
description: Bar button that opens a popup and plays a random video right inline. Sources can be a URL that already serves a different video on each request, or a shell command whose output is such a URL (for sites like ytroulette.com where getting it takes real client-side logic). Either way the result is resolved with yt-dlp and played in the popup, with a reroll button for another pick and a one-click launch into mpv for its own window (with sound).
